hyperate.connected.description: Runs when Cuebot connects to HypeRate. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

variables.sessionId: The HypeRate ID you are watching

hyperate.disconnected.description: Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to HypeRate. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

hyperate.heartRate.description: Runs for every new heart rate reading from HypeRate. It can run about once a second, so keep the action short.

variables.heartRate: Heart rate right now, in beats per minute
variables.previousHeartRate: The heart rate before this one
variables.source: Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate

hyperate.heartRateChanged.description: Runs when your HypeRate heart rate changes enough. Good for updating a number on screen without running every second.

fields.minInterval: The least number of seconds to wait between runs. 5 means at most one run every five seconds.
fields.minChange: Only run when your heart rate moved at least this many beats per minute since the last run.

variables.heartRate: Heart rate right now, in beats per minute
variables.previousHeartRate: The heart rate before this one
variables.source: Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate
variables.lastTriggeredHeartRate: The heart rate at the last run
variables.heartRateChange: How much it changed since then (minus means it fell)

hyperate.heartRateAbove.description: Runs once when your HypeRate heart rate reaches a number you pick or goes higher. Fun for a "calm down!" moment.

fields.threshold: The heart rate to watch for, in beats per minute. It runs when you reach this number or higher.
fields.hysteresis: How far your heart rate must fall below the threshold before this can run again. Stops it firing over and over when you hover near the number.

variables.heartRate: Heart rate right now, in beats per minute
variables.previousHeartRate: The heart rate before this one
variables.source: Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate

hyperate.heartRateBelow.description: Runs once when your HypeRate heart rate drops to a number you pick or lower. Fun for a "are you still alive?" moment.

fields.threshold: The heart rate to watch for, in beats per minute. It runs when you reach this number or lower.
fields.hysteresis: How far your heart rate must rise above the threshold before this can run again. Stops it firing over and over when you hover near the number.

variables.heartRate: Heart rate right now, in beats per minute
variables.previousHeartRate: The heart rate before this one
variables.source: Where it came from: Pulsoid or HypeRate

hyperate.clipCreated.description: Runs when a Twitch clip is made through HypeRate. Handy to share the clip link in chat.

variables.clipUrl: The web link to the clip
